blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — Hog raisers in Oriental Mindoro have joined a nationwide three-day “pork holiday” from Thursday to Saturday (October 22 to 24) to protest the continued drop in farmgate prices of hogs and other challenges facing the local industry. The Oriental Mindoro Alliance of United Hog Raisers said it is heeding the call of AGAP Party-list Rep. Nicanor Briones to temporarily suspend selling hogs as part of a collective protest by hog raisers. The farmers attribute the declining prices largely to the influx of imported pork in local markets.
